name: cloudflare-deploy
description: Publish a page to Cloudflare Pages behind a Cloudflare Access email login, and change who is allowed in — without ever putting the API token in a conversation.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: Account-scoped custom token with exactly two permissions: Cloudflare Pages -> Edit, and Access: Apps and Policies -> Edit. Under Account Resources, pin it to the single account you publish into. Stored in your OS keychain, never sent to Claude.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Found in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar. Supplying it lets the token drop the Account Settings: Read permission entirely.
